products.datasource_description: One row per SKU (Product Id): the current product master with merchandise hierarchy, attributes and current supplier.

columns.Style Code: Style that groups the size variants of a SKU (ST-...). Apparel styles have 4 SKUs (one per size); every other SKU has a style of its own.
columns.Product Name: Display name of the SKU, including its variant.
columns.Category: Top level of the merchandise hierarchy: camp_hike, outdoor_apparel, patio_garden, home_comfort.
columns.Subcategory: Second level of the merchandise hierarchy, below Category.
columns.Brand: Brand of the SKU: the retailer's own private label or a third-party national brand, as classified in Brand Type.
columns.Brand Type: private_label (the retailer's own label) or national_brand (third-party brand).
columns.Color: Color of the SKU. Always filled for outdoor_apparel; empty for all patio_garden SKUs and for many camp_hike and home_comfort SKUs.
columns.Size: Size of sized items: S, M, L, XL for apparel; 8 to 11 for footwear. Empty for items without sizes.
columns.Seasonality Profile: Seasonality class of the SKU (e.g. spring_summer, shoulder, holiday).
columns.Weight Lb: Shipping weight of one unit in pounds, including packaging; a per-unit attribute.
columns.Is Oversize: True when the item ships as a bulky or oversize parcel or as freight (e.g. patio furniture, large grills, fire pits).
columns.Is Hazmat: True for items with shipping restrictions (e.g. fuel canisters, propane heaters).
columns.Case Pack Qty: Units per inner case; a per-SKU attribute.
columns.Supplier Id: Primary supplier currently assigned to the SKU (SUP-...), not history: a SKU that changed supplier shows only the current one.
columns.Launch Date: First date the SKU was sellable online. Dates before 2023-01-01 mark the established assortment.
columns.Discontinue Date: Date the SKU was set to discontinued (no new purchasing; remaining stock can still sell). Empty while active.

invoices.datasource_description: One row per invoice (Invoice Id), one per shipment, so an order shipped in parts has several.

columns.Invoice Id: Invoice identifier (INV-...). One invoice per shipment, so an order shipped in parts has several invoices.
columns.Order Id: Order billed by the invoice (O-...). Appears on more than one invoice when the order shipped in parts.
columns.Shipment Id: Shipment that produced the invoice (SH-...); one invoice per shipment.
columns.Channel: Sales channel of the invoiced order: web, app, marketplace, b2b.
columns.State Code: Ship-to US state of the invoiced shipment (2-letter code, incl. DC).
columns.Invoice Date: Revenue recognition date: the day the invoiced shipment left the warehouse. Calendar date; the fiscal period is in Fiscal Month.
columns.Payment Terms: Payment terms: prepaid (web, app), net30 (b2b), marketplace_settlement (marketplace).
columns.Due Date: Payment due date; equals Invoice Date for prepaid terms.
columns.Shipping Billed Amount: Shipping charge billed on this invoice in USD, before tax: the order's full charge on its first invoice, 0 on later ones and when shipping is free.
columns.Shipping Tax Amount: Sales tax billed on shipping in USD; 0 where shipping is not taxed.
columns.Marketplace Fee Amount: Fee withheld by the marketplace on this invoice in USD, on merchandise plus shipping excl. tax; gross of later fee reversals. 0 for other channels.
columns.Campaign Id: Last-click marketing campaign of the order (CMP-...). Empty when the order had no campaign, and for all marketplace and b2b orders.
columns.Sales Region Id: Region stamped at posting from the territory map valid on the Invoice Date. Map changed 2025-01-01: new R-MOUNTAIN took parts of R-WEST and R-SOUTH.
columns.Fiscal Month: Fiscal month of invoice posting (e.g. FY2024-P06). Fiscal year starts February 1: FY2024-P01 = February 2024, FY2024-P12 = January 2025.

invoice_lines.datasource_description: One row per invoice line (Invoice Line Id): one order line on one invoice.

columns.Invoice Line Id: Invoice line identifier (IL-...): one order line on one invoice.
columns.Order Line Id: Order line billed (OL-...). A line shipped in parts appears on several invoice lines.
columns.Qty Invoiced: Units invoiced on the line, equal to the units shipped for it.
columns.Unit Price: Selling price per unit before discounts, in USD: list price for web/app, listing price for marketplace, contract price for b2b.
columns.Discount Amount: Discount on the invoiced units in USD: line promotion pro-rated to invoiced units plus allocated share of the order coupon. Excludes cancelled units.
columns.Tax Amount: Sales tax on the invoiced units in USD. For marketplace orders the marketplace collects and remits it.
columns.Unit Standard Cost: Standard cost per unit valid on the invoice's date, in USD (standard cost, not actual cost).

credit_memos.datasource_description: One row per credit memo line (Credit Memo Id): one reversal of invoiced revenue for one customer refund.

columns.Credit Memo Id: Credit memo line identifier (CM-...): one reversal posted.
columns.Refund Id: Customer refund the credit memo books (RF-...); every memo line has one.
columns.Invoice Id: Original invoice being reversed; for order-level reversals, the order's first invoice.
columns.Order Line Id: Order line reversed (OL-...). Empty for order-level reversals such as shipping refunds, goodwill allowances and price adjustments.
columns.Product Id: SKU reversed (P-...). Empty for order-level reversals.
columns.Memo Type: Accounting category of the reversal: return, allowance, shipping, price_adjustment. Only return memos carry credited units.
columns.Credit Memo Date: Posting date of the credit memo. Memos post in a weekly batch after the refund, so they can fall in a later fiscal month than the original invoice.
columns.Qty Credited: Units reversed. Non-zero only on return memos; 0 for allowances, shipping and price adjustments.
columns.Merchandise Credit Amount: Merchandise revenue reversed in USD, excluding tax and shipping.
columns.Shipping Credit Amount: Shipping revenue reversed in USD, excluding tax.
columns.Marketplace Fee Reversal Amount: Part of the marketplace fee returned by the marketplace on the refund, in USD; usually less than the fee withheld. 0 for other channels.
columns.Sales Region Id: Sales region stamped at credit memo posting. Map changed 2025-01-01: new R-MOUNTAIN took parts of R-WEST and R-SOUTH.
columns.Fiscal Month: Fiscal month in which the credit memo posted (e.g. FY2024-P06; fiscal year starting February 1). Often later than the month of the original invoice.

orders.datasource_description: One row per order (Order Id): one checkout, marketplace order import, or b2b order entry, in all channels.

columns.Order Id: Order identifier (O-...): one per checkout, marketplace order import, or b2b order entry.
columns.Order At: Timestamp the order was placed, in US Eastern time as stored by the order system.
columns.Order Date: Date part of Order At in US Eastern time; late-evening Pacific orders fall on the next date.
columns.Customer Id: Ordering customer (C-...). Marketplace buyers are registered per marketplace handle, so one person can have two customer IDs.
columns.Session Id: Web or app session in which the order was placed (S-...). Empty for marketplace and b2b orders.
columns.Channel: Sales channel of the order: web, app, marketplace, b2b.
columns.State Code: Ship-to US state of the order (2-letter code, incl. DC), not the customer's home state.
columns.Sales Rep Id: Account executive credited with the order (REP-...). Filled for b2b orders only; empty otherwise.
columns.Promotion Id: Order-level promotion applied at checkout (coupon code or free-shipping offer), PRM-.... Empty if none.
columns.Shipping Method: Delivery speed selected at checkout: standard, expedited, freight.
columns.Promised Delivery Date: Latest delivery date shown to the customer at checkout (the customer promise).
columns.Shipping Charge Amount: Shipping fee charged for the whole order in USD, before tax; charged once even if the order ships in several shipments. 0 when shipping is free.
columns.Shipping Tax Amount: Sales tax charged on shipping in USD; 0 where shipping is not taxed.
columns.Order Discount Amount: Order-level coupon discount for the whole order in USD; not allocated to lines and not reduced when units are cancelled. 0 if none.
columns.Payment Method: How the order is paid: card, digital_wallet, net30_terms, marketplace_settlement.
columns.Campaign Id: Last-click campaign stamped from the session's tracking parameters (CMP-...). Empty for non-campaign, marketplace and b2b orders.
columns.Loyalty Tier: Customer's loyalty tier at the time of the order: basic, silver, gold. Empty if not enrolled.

order_lines.datasource_description: One row per order line (Order Line Id): one SKU in one order.

columns.Order Line Id: Order line identifier (OL-...): one SKU in one order.
columns.Line Number: Position of the line within the order, starting at 1.
columns.Promotion Id: Line-level promotion (product markdown or bundle offer) that produced Line Discount Amount (PRM-...). Empty if none.
columns.Qty Ordered: Units requested by the customer, including units later cancelled or backordered.
columns.Qty Backordered: Units not in stock at any warehouse at order time and placed on backorder, later shipped or cancelled. 0 if fully available.
columns.Qty Cancelled: Units cancelled before shipment, at order time or later. 0 if none.
columns.Cancel Reason: Reason for the cancelled units (e.g. out_of_stock, backorder_timeout). Empty when no units were cancelled.
columns.Cancelled Date: Date the cancellation was recorded. Empty when no units were cancelled.
columns.Unit List Price: List price per unit at order time from the merchandising price list, in USD.
columns.Unit Price: Selling price per unit before line discount, in USD: list for web/app, listing for marketplace (can exceed list), contract for b2b (below list).
columns.Line Discount Amount: Line-level promotional discount for all ordered units on the line, in USD; not reduced when units are cancelled. Excludes the order-level coupon.
columns.Tax Amount: Sales tax on the line at order time for all ordered units, in USD. For marketplace orders the marketplace collects and remits it.
columns.Unit Standard Cost: Standard cost per unit at order time, in USD (standard cost, not actual cost).
columns.Allocated Warehouse Id: Warehouse allocated at order time: WH-W, WH-C, WH-E; not necessarily the one that shipped. Empty for lines cancelled before allocation.

web_searches.datasource_description: One row per on-site search (Search Id) executed in a web or app session.

columns.Session Id: Session in which the search ran (S-...).
columns.Query Text: Search query as normalized by the search engine (lowercase, trimmed).
columns.Search Input Type: How the query was entered: typed, autocomplete, suggested_after_no_results.
columns.Results Count: Number of active products matching the query, regardless of stock; 0 means no product matched.
columns.Results In Stock Count: Of Results Count, products shown as in stock or low stock at the visitor's serving warehouse; 0 means nothing purchasable was shown.
columns.Clicked Product Id: First product clicked from the results (P-...). Empty if no result was clicked.
columns.Clicked Result Position: 1-based rank of the clicked product in the result list. Empty if no click.

shipments.datasource_description: One row per shipment (Shipment Id): one parcel group leaving one warehouse with one carrier.

columns.Shipment Id: Shipment identifier (SH-...): one parcel group leaving one warehouse with one carrier.
columns.Order Id: Order being fulfilled (O-...); an order shipped in parts has several shipments.
columns.Shipment Number: Sequence of the shipment within its order, starting at 1.
columns.Carrier Name: Name of the carrier for Carrier Id (six carriers).
columns.Carrier Type: Carrier network type: national_parcel, regional_parcel, ltl_freight.
columns.Service Level: Carrier service purchased: ground, two_day, ltl_freight.
columns.Shipped At: Carrier pickup scan time at the warehouse.
columns.Shipped Date: Date part of Shipped At: the day the shipment left the warehouse.
columns.Carrier Estimated Delivery Date: Delivery date estimated by the carrier at pickup.
columns.Delivered At: Carrier delivery scan time. Empty if not delivered: still in transit, lost, or returned to sender.
columns.Delivered Date: Date part of Delivered At. Empty if not delivered: still in transit, lost, or returned to sender.
columns.Delivery Status: Latest carrier tracking status (current value, not a history): delivered, in_transit, lost, returned_to_sender.
columns.Package Count: Number of cartons in the shipment.
columns.Billed Weight Lbs: Billable weight of the shipment in pounds reported by the carrier (greater of actual and dimensional weight).
columns.Freight Cost Amount: Transportation cost billed by the carrier for this shipment in USD, incl. surcharges. Incurred even when the customer got free shipping.
columns.State Code: Ship-to US state of the shipment (2-letter code, incl. DC).
columns.Order Date: Date the order was placed (US Eastern time), carried on each shipment of the order.
columns.Promised Delivery Date: Latest delivery date promised to the customer at checkout, carried on each shipment of the order.

shipment_lines.datasource_description: One row per shipment line (Shipment Line Id): one order line in one shipment.

columns.Shipment Line Id: Shipment line identifier (SL-...): one order line in one shipment.
columns.Order Line Id: Order line being fulfilled (OL-...); a line shipped in parts appears in several shipments.
columns.Warehouse Id: Origin warehouse of the line's shipment: WH-W, WH-C, WH-E.
columns.Shipped Date: Date the line left the warehouse (its shipment's ship date).

returns.datasource_description: One row per return authorization line (Return Id); an order line can be returned in more than one authorization.

columns.Return Id: Return authorization line identifier (RT-...): one order line returned once; a line can be returned in more than one authorization.
columns.Order Id: Original order of the returned item (O-...).
columns.Warehouse Id: Warehouse that received the return: WH-W, WH-C, WH-E. Empty if the goods were never received.
columns.Requested At: Time the return was requested (portal, support ticket, or marketplace).
columns.Requested Date: Date part of Requested At: the customer's request, not the receipt of the goods.
columns.Received Date: Date the goods arrived at the warehouse. Empty if not (yet) received.
columns.Return Window Days: Return window in days under the policy in force when the item was delivered: 30 or 60.
columns.Return Reason: Reason selected by the customer for the return.
columns.Return Method: How the goods came back: prepaid_label, customer_shipped, freight_pickup, marketplace_return.
columns.Return Status: Latest status of the return (current value, not a history).
columns.Qty Requested: Units the customer asked to return.
columns.Qty Received: Units physically received at the warehouse; 0 if not received.
columns.Item Condition: Inspection result of the received units: resellable, damaged, defective. Empty if not received.
columns.Qty Restocked: Units put back into sellable stock on Restock Date; 0 if none.
columns.Restock Date: Date restocked units became available in inventory. Empty when nothing was restocked.
columns.Return Shipping Cost Amount: Return label or pickup cost paid by the company, in USD; 0 when the customer paid return shipping.
columns.Order Date: Date the original order was placed.
columns.Shipped Date: Ship date of the returned order line, carried on the return.
columns.Delivered Date: Delivery date of the returned line; the return window is counted from this date.

refunds.datasource_description: One row per refund payment to a customer (Refund Id), with or without a return.

columns.Refund Id: Refund identifier (RF-...): one refund payment to a customer.
columns.Return Id: Return the refund relates to (RT-...). Empty for refunds without a return: goodwill, shipping refunds and price adjustments.
columns.Order Line Id: Order line refunded (OL-...). Empty for refunds without a return, which are booked at order level.
columns.Ticket Id: Support ticket that triggered the refund (TK-...). Filled for refunds without a return; empty for refunds tied to a return.
columns.Refund Type: Why money was returned: return, returnless (both tied to a return), shipping_refund, goodwill, price_adjustment (no return).
columns.Refund Method: Where the money went: original_payment, store_credit, marketplace. Store credit is not cash paid out.
columns.Refunded Date: Date part of Refunded At: the day the refund was issued.
columns.Merchandise Refund Amount: Merchandise value refunded in USD, net of the discount originally given; excludes tax and shipping.

web_sessions.datasource_description: One row per web or app session (Session Id) recorded by the analytics tool.

columns.Session Id: Session identifier issued by the analytics tool (S-...).
columns.Visitor Id: Anonymous device or browser identifier (cookie or app install). One visitor can have many sessions; one person on two devices is two visitors.
columns.Customer Id: Customer identified during the session by login, checkout, or a personalized email link (C-...). Empty for anonymous sessions.
columns.Session Start Date: Date the session started; a session that orders after midnight keeps the earlier date.
columns.Channel: Channel of the session: web or app.
columns.Device Type: Device category reported by the analytics tool: desktop, mobile, tablet.
columns.State Code: US state estimated from the visitor's IP (2-letter code, incl. DC); sets the serving warehouse whose stock is shown. Not a ship-to or home address.
columns.Traffic Source: Acquisition source under the analytics tool's last non-direct click rule: a direct return visit keeps the previous paid source for 30 days.
columns.Campaign Id: Campaign from tracking parameters (CMP-...). Always empty for direct, organic_search, organic_social and referral sessions; empty for some email and push.
columns.Landing Page Type: Type of the first page of the session.
columns.Page Views: Pageviews or app screen views in the session.
columns.Product Views: Product detail page views in the session.
columns.Oos Product Views: Product detail page views where the product showed out of stock for the visitor's serving warehouse. Counts views, not products; reloads count again.
columns.Cart Added Date: Date of the first add-to-cart in the session. Empty if nothing was added.
columns.Qty Added To Cart: Units added to cart during the session; removals are not subtracted. 0 if nothing was added.
columns.Checkout Started Date: Date checkout was started. Empty if the session never reached checkout.
columns.Order Id: Order completed in this session (O-...). Empty when no order; earlier sessions of the same visitor do not carry it.
columns.Tracked Order Amount: Purchase value in USD tracked at checkout: merchandise after discounts, shipping and tax. Not reduced by later cancellations or returns. Empty if no order.
